name: Platform Readiness Rubric
checks: Can load folder, files, zip, and pasted source without server-side auth.
Can persist and reload workspaces locally with project contents, report output, patch output, proof ledger, and seed registry.
Can ingest seed files from platform-seed/ manifest, uploaded seed folders, and seed zips.
Can generate deterministic proof ledgers without AI/provider calls.
Can export proof pack for operator handoff.
Uses kAIxuGateway13 only for model calls; no direct OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini browser calls.
Has a repeatable smoke script that validates inline JavaScript and seed manifest references.
